messages:
jess: Heads-up: customer reported intermittent SSO failures during onboarding. Frontend shows SAML error 'invalid_response', backend logs have a mix of 502 from our proxy to IdP and 'scim.provisioner: deprov mismatch' entries. Anyone on call?

omar: Ping, I'm here. Can you dump the log window and SAML response? 502 to IdP suggests either a transient IdP outage or our egress NAT rules.

jess: Logs: 
```
2026-04-05T14:05:12Z ERROR http.proxy: upstream 502 idp=saml.corp-ids tenant=acme-corp path=/saml/acs
2026-04-05T14:05:14Z WARN scim.provisioner: deprov mismatch tenant=acme-corp user=alice extid=EX-1234 reason="extid fingerprint mismatch"
2026-04-05T14:05:15Z ERROR kms: decrypt failed key_alias=alias/redwood-prod err="invalid key context"
```

kelly: Looks like three things: (1) temporary IdP 502, (2) extid fingerprint mismatch caused by different normalization or signing context, (3) a KMS context error. They often cluster around key rotations or schema changes in the extid normalization.

ray: Quick checks: verify egress to IdP (run `curl -v https://saml.corp-ids/health` from egress host), check last KMS alias rotate (`git log -p deploy/infra/kms_alias`), and query provisioning_audit for extid normalization changes (`SELECT * FROM provisioning_audit WHERE tenant='acme-corp' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50`).

jess: Egress OK from hosts. IdP health endpoint returns 200. But trace from our proxy shows a TLS handshake failure with the IdP at 14:05:12 which caused the 502. The IdP rotated their certs around that time.

omar: Cert rotation at IdP could explain transient 502s. For the extid fingerprint mismatch, we need to check whether extids were signed/rewrapped during our last KMS rotate. Which alias is active? `echo $REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS` -> `alias/redwood-prod-v3`. Tenant record extid_wrap_alias = `alias/redwood-prod`. That mismatch will cause verify/decrypt failures until rewrap.

kelly: Mitigation: pause provisioning for acme-corp, run rewrap from alias/redwood-prod -> alias/redwood-prod-v3 for tenant extids, but first dry-run. Also ensure RBAC mappings won't be affected by normalization changes: run `python tools/compare_roles.py --tenant acme-corp`

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-102 | Priority: P2 | Tags: saml,scim,kms | Owner: unassigned

ray: Add a short-term compatibility check in control plane: when decrypt fails with context mismatch, try previous N aliases before surfacing fatal error. We'll follow up with RFC.

jess: Running dry-run rewrap -> `rewrap found 87 objects, sample verify OK`. Proceeding with apply.

omar: While rewrap runs, notify customer success that onboarding may be delayed and watch provisioning_audit for unexpected role changes. Also capture any SAML responses for failed logins to correlate with cert rotation timeline.

kelly: Postmortem actions: 1) require an IdP cert rotation smoke-test (handshake checks from our edge) before accepting traffic. 2) include tenant rewrap as part of KMS alias rotate playbook. 3) implement alias-fallback verify path for N=3 previous aliases. 4) add an alert for 'extid fingerprint mismatch' tied to KMS rotate events.

jess: Rewrap applied: 87 rewrapped, 0 errors. Resuming provisioning queue at 14:29 UTC.

ops-bot: Queue resumed for tenant acme-corp at 2026-04-05T14:29:30Z.

omar: Metrics: provisioning success back to baseline, no RBAC deltas found in provisioning_audit. Closing INC-2026-102 once customer confirms onboarding complete.

jess: Thanks team. I'll write up the runbook and add the alias-fallback RFC to the backlog. :white_check_mark:
